exact_Schur_proof.spaces: Hilbert space HP direct-sum HQ, orthogonal projection P. Complement means space HQ, not a finite set of one-step outgoing rows. Q=1-P denotes a projection; D is its Hamiltonian.
exact_Schur_proof.domain: A and D selfadjoint on their own domains, B:HP->HQ bounded. H=[[A,B*,],[B,D]] on D(A) direct-sum D(D) is selfadjoint by bounded perturbation. Finite-dimensional shell A is sufficient but not necessary. Selfadjoint full H alone is not an assumption-free authorization to treat an arbitrary QHQ compression as selfadjoint: establish this domain decomposition. For finite-rank P with ran P subset D(H), the bounded off-diagonal reduction supplies selfadjoint diagonal blocks.
exact_Schur_proof.same_center: Fix one real lambda, eta>0, T=H-lambda+i eta, TA=A-lambda+i eta, TD=D-lambda+i eta. RF=T^-1, RA=TA^-1, RD=TD^-1 all have norm <=eta^-1. No spectrum positivity, ground vector, complement gap, finite-dimensional complement, or commuting block is required.
exact_Schur_proof.elimination: Solve TD y+B x=0 to get y=-RD B x. Thus P RF P=(TA-B* RD B)^-1=G. Sigma=B* RD B has norm <=||B||^2/eta. G is a compression of RF so ||G||<=eta^-1, not a small-Sigma or Neumann-series assumption.
exact_Schur_proof.resolvent_identity: G-RA=RA Sigma G. Therefore ||P RF P-RA||<=||B||^2/eta^3<=Ctotal^2/eta^3. Bilinear error for identical x_a,x_b in HP is <=||x_a||||x_b|| Ctotal^2/eta^3. This is exact, including all complex cross entries and arbitrary noncommutation.
exact_Schur_proof.extra_PHP: If evaluated A0 differs from actual PHP=A0+K, the Schur bound to A0 needs an additional ||K||/eta^2 term. B alone does not pay K: B=0 with K nonzero is an exact falsifier. A field-form error not bounded in operator norm needs a separate form-resolvent estimate; the bounded-K expression does not pretend otherwise.
exact_Schur_proof.reference_shift: Changing lambda to lambda+delta adds at most |delta|/eta^2 for identical sources. This is not paid by B. Neither full E0 nor full P0 equals a compressed ground energy/projector by this theorem.
exact_Schur_proof.finite_shell: The 10384 reported outgoing NN rows contain ran B for the NN finite shell, but are not an invariant or full complement. The theorem permits an arbitrary selfadjoint continuation on HQ and hence does not substitute the outgoing finite matrix for D. The existing 681-dimensional numeric A and NN response remain FLOAT observations at their own center and sources.
